Record Class Argon2PhcString

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.security.password.argon2.Argon2PhcString
Record Components:
memory - the memory cost, in kibibytes
iterations - the number of iterations
parallelism - the degree of parallelism
salt - the salt
hash - the hash
@Internal public record Argon2PhcString(long memory, long iterations, int parallelism, byte[] salt, byte[] hash) extends Record
An Argon2id hash in the PHC string format: $argon2id$v=19$m=<memory>,t=<iterations>,p=<parallelism>$<salt>$<hash>.

Parsing is strict. Only Argon2id version 19 is accepted, the parameters must appear in the order m,t,p as decimals without leading zeros, and the salt and hash must be canonical unpadded Base64. The optional keyid and data parameters are not supported.

Since:
5.5.0
